narrative: Marcus, 34, is a software engineer training for a half-marathon whose progress has stalled and whose energy has dropped — which he's chalked up to training harder without results.
He doesn't know it yet, but a routine physical 8 months ago showed a borderline-high TSH he never followed up on.
This profile is a composite: the wearable data is a real, unmodified 90-day Fitbit record from a different person.
The diagnosed condition (idiopathic atrophic hypothyroidism) and Levothyroxine prescription come from a separate synthetic FHIR patient — stitched together by narrative only, not a shared identity.

83664006.pathway: Idiopathic atrophic (autoimmune) hypothyroidism causes a metabolic slowdown — fatigue, cold intolerance, and a training plateau despite steadily rising step counts, which is exactly what the wearable trend shows for this profile.
